cross_lane_invariants.rule: Local PPO training output is not formal evidence for any lane.
Any new success-attempt remote training requires an approved or frozen new/revised contract first.
The failed warm-start checkpoint can be negative evidence only, not a success checkpoint.
Paper result material requires H02 formal_output_accepted=true and paper_result_input_allowed=true.
